title: Laf822’s “Ill be” is a love song that speaks to the heart
htmlContent:
When it comes to encapsulating love in a few minute's worth of song, Laf822's newest track, "Ill be," featuring 822sweetcandy, does the song justice sonically and emotionally. This is a heartfelt alter call rolled up in an irresistible song that we guarantee will be a song every single moment that you find yourself somewhere near love. "Ill be" is a song that the right melody can just sneak into your head and have you smiling without even knowing it. But what really makes this track is the layers of meaningful lyrics that Laf822 and 822sweetcandy weave over that infectious rhythm.

The words plunge into the deeper end of how love is and sling metaphors and punch lines together in a way that feels fresh and thoughtful. "Ill Be" sounds like a two-part conversation between two people who realize that love is far from perfect but give themselves to it wholeheartedly nonetheless. The smart metaphors are like little gems that offer a richness to the song, beckoning listeners to dive into the onion's layers of feeling buried beneath a catchy chorus. It's a thinking, related song and one to share with someone special. 822sweetcandy, gives a glistening partnership to Laf822’s flow.

https://open.spotify.com/track/78CBsj4JsYz5il2z78DG3Z

Together, their voices provide the perfect touch of warmth and energy to give the track a truly vibrant, organic feel. If you're falling in love for the first time, wanting to hang onto a deep connection, or just craving a love song that stands for something, "Ill be" is one to add to your playlist. It's evidence that love songs can be catchy, clever, heartfelt, and fun. What Laf822 and 822sweetcandy have come up with here is a record that will soundtrack many love stories. Prepare for repeat pressing because "Ill Be" is the love song that seeps deep into your head and heart.
